ideas.title: The Message From Ten Years Ahead
ideas.one_sentence_premise: A young man receives nightly messages from himself ten years in the future, until one message tells him to stop trusting the sender.
ideas.hook: Every night at 11:47, Kai receives a message from himself.
ideas.twist: The man at the door who looks exactly like Kai is not the one who sent the messages.

ideas.title: The Forgotten Neighbor
ideas.one_sentence_premise: Everyone in a small city forgets one person at the same instant, and nobody can say who is missing.
ideas.hook: Last night, every person in this city forgot someone.
ideas.twist: The narrator realizes the missing person is the one telling the story.
